summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an auto-loan asset-backed securitization takedown by Porsche Financial Auto Securitization Trust 2026-1, comprising $200.0M Class A-1, $225.5M Class A-2a, $100.0M Class A-2b, $325.5M Class A-3 and $60.0M Class A-4 notes, all told roughly $911.0M. The filing satisfies an undertaking to furnish unqualified legality and tax opinions from Mayer Brown LLP dated September 25, 2026. No board recommendation, price per share, premium, ownership change or regulatory clock is implicated; this is ordinary shelf ABS execution, not a special situation.
